table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	TodayDate = GetDate(),
	AppointmentCode=AppointmentCode,
	DoctCode,
	DueDate,
	Date,
	Regno = (SELECT Patient.RegNo FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = VisitAppointment.PatientCode),
	PatientName = ISNULL((SELECT Patient.Name FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = VisitAppointment.PatientCode), PatientDetails),
	FName = (SELECT Patient.FName FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = VisitAppointment.PatientCode),
	ContactNumbers = (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(Patient.Phone, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Patient.Phone2, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Patient.MobileNo1, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Patient.MobileNo2, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Patient.MobileNo3, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Patient.MobileNo3, ''))) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = VisitAppointment.PatientCode), 
	PatientCode,
	AppointmentStatusCode,
	TokenNo,
	UserName = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = VisitAppointment.UserCode),
	Source = 'Appointment',
	Paid = CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(PatientCode) FROM ServiceHeader WHERE DoctCode = :al_doctcode AND Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND PatientCode = VisitAppointment.PatientCode) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
FROM
	VisitAppointment
WHERE
	DoctCode = :al_doctcode AND
	DueDate BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	TodayDate = GetDate(),
	AppointmentCode=NULL,
	DoctCode,
	DueDate,
	Date,
	Regno = (SELECT Patient.RegNo FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = ServiceHeader.PatientCode),
	PatientName = (SELECT Patient.Name FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = ServiceHeader.PatientCode), 
	FName = (SELECT Patient.FName FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = ServiceHeader.PatientCode),
	ContactNumbers = (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(Patient.Phone, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Patient.Phone2, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Patient.MobileNo1, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Patient.MobileNo2, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Patient.MobileNo3, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Patient.MobileNo3, ''))) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = ServiceHeader.PatientCode), 
	PatientCode,
	AppointmentStatusCode=NULL,
	TokenNo,
	UserName = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = ServiceHeader.SalesmanCode),
	Source = 'Service Walk-IN',
	Paid = 'Y'
FROM
	ServiceHeader
WHERE
	DoctCode = :al_doctcode AND
	Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND 
	PatientCode NOT IN 
		(SELECT PatientCode 
		FROM
			VisitAppointment
		WHERE
			DoctCode = :al_doctcode AND
			DueDate BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate)
